messages:
lee: deploy-bot scheduled UNPIN runtime v4.0 -> v4.1 for canary at 03:00 UTC. tagging runtime/qa/sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN runtime v4.0 -> v4.1 (canary). Trigger: nightly-runtime-window. ETA: 03:00 UTC.
sam: Quick check: v4.1 changes the kernel selection for int8 quant paths; regression detected in local smoke for model 'mistral-lite'.
qa-ana: Repro: `./smoke --model mistral-lite --runtime v4.1 --profile int8` -> token mismatch and assert in kv_bind.
qa-ana: Error:
``
AssertionError: expected kernel 'kv_bind_int8_v4' but got 'kv_bind_int8_v3'
```
runtime-julie: Looks like the alias table lost the new v4 alias. I can PR a tiny alias-add fix.
lee: PAUSE unpin until runtime team confirms. Potential canary break for int8 workloads.
deploy-bot: PAUSE unpin action for thread 2999001234. Reason: kernel alias regression investigation. (requested by lee)
runtime-julie: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2110 "fix: restore int8 kv_bind alias for mistral-lite". Adding a smoke test too.
qa-ana: CI ETA ~18m. I'll stand up a 5% canary for int8 models once artifact available.
sre-rob: I'll add alert for kv_bind_assert rate > 0.01% during rollout.
qa-ana: CI green (2999001320). Artifact ready: runtime:v4.1-hotfix-2110.
lee: Starting scoped canary at 03:45 UTC to 5% of canary fleet (int8-only).
qa-ana: Canary checks: no kv_bind asserts, latency normal.
sam: Good to proceed. Resume unpin and follow normal staged rollout.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN: proceeding with staged canary -> remaining canary -> regional rollouts.
lee: Notifying support and closing thread. Thanks for the fast turnaround.
